cd /workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
src=open('scratch/report.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
lines=src.split('\n')
out=[];inside=False
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^##\s',ln):
        if inside: break
        if ln.strip()=='## 风险':
            inside=True
            continue
    if inside: out.append(ln)
text='\n'.join(out).strip()
open('scratch/risk.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(text+'\n')
EOF
cat -A scratch/risk.txt; echo ----; md5sum scratch/report.md; file scratch/risk.txt
